dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the wide mid-section towards the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical inward indentation visible on the right lateral margin where the mid-body transitions to the peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform light-grey tone across the dorsal surface, with a median pixel intensity characteristic of a sub-adult or juvenile.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast dark aperture (blowhole) located on the anterior dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced longitudinal ridge/indentation along the central dorsal axis of the posterior peduncle leading toward the tail region.
